results.title: Mahavatar Narsimha
results.overview: Tyrannical demon Hiranyakashyap challenges Vishnu, proclaiming himself a god. However, his son Prahlad remains devoted to Vishnu, who appears as Narsimha to defeat the demon.

results.title: Taylor Swift | The Eras Tour | The Final Show
results.original_title: Taylor Swift | The Eras Tour | The Final Show
results.overview: Filmed at the end of Taylor Swift's record-breaking Eras Tour in Vancouver, B.C., this complete, in-depth 45-song concert includes the complete 'The Tortured Poets Department' set and special mashups.

results.title: Your Letter
results.overview: After summer vacation, So-ri transfers to a new school and finds an anonymous letter in her desk drawer with an introduction to the school and a clue to finding the next letter.  While following the clues in the letters and searching all over the school like on a treasure hunt, So-ri keeps running into a same-aged student named Dong-soon. So-ri and Dong-soon quickly become friends as they search for the letters together. As she finds one letter after another, the special connection continues, and So-ri's curiosity grows for the mysterious sender.

results.title: Holiday Touchdown: A Bills Love Story
results.original_title: Holiday Touchdown: A Bills Love Story
results.overview: The Quinns and DeLucas have lived next door to each other for decades in the shadow of Highmark Stadium – the home of their beloved Buffalo Bills. With their longtime friendship rooted in being proud members of Bills Mafia, the two clans have enjoyed cherished traditions that revolve around cheering for their favorite team – especially at the holidays when they celebrate the last home game before Christmas.

results.title: The Truce
results.overview: Karlag, short for Karaganda Corrective Labor Camp, was one of the largest labor camps within the Soviet Gulag system. Established in 1931, it was located in the Karagandy Region of Kazakhstan. The film will explore the hardships faced by people during the 1930s-1950s and the resilience of human dignity despite the daily struggle for survival. The atmosphere of Karlag will be conveyed through costumes, props, and sets created after extensive research in archives and museums.

results.title: Naloxone
results.overview: A renowned doctor faces an ethical dilemma when a patient with an overdose is admitted to the emergency room; he faces the choice of saving the patient or taking justice into his own hands to make him pay for a crime he committed.

results.title: Feliz Aniversário
results.overview: Bernardo invites his mistress to his lovely house in the country, intending to spoil her for her birthday. His wife Joana, who is initially supposed to visit her mother, decides not to leave the house upon knowing Roberto, Bernardo's best friend - and her lover - was also invited to the celebrations.

results.title: The Keeping
results.overview: After his parents go missing, Ryan returns home where the mysterious reappearance of his high school girlfriend initiates a series of increasingly mind bending events which eventually reveal the shocking truth of his childhood.

results.title: Our Party
results.overview: Katherine Mansfield’s The Garden Party is modernised in this contemplative short, following teenage Laura as she hosts a party up the road from a mourning family.

results.title: Salute to the Pig!
results.overview: In the 1999 Timor war, Darius (40), a financially strapped father, fights to protect a state-owned priceless sandalwood tree in his front yard from thieves, while struggling to support his daughter’s dream of joining the military.

results.title: Weavers
results.overview: A women's support group takes in Olivia, who is vulnerable after the death of her twin sister Patricia. But in this sect, the peace she hoped for becomes her worst nightmare.

results.title: Primavera
results.overview: A talented violinist, Cecilia, confined in an orphanage, meets Vivaldi who becomes her teacher. Under his mentorship and through his music, she gains courage to break free from the life she was destined for and pursue her passion.

results.title: Jewel Thief - The Heist Begins
results.overview: In this high-octane battle of wits and wills, ingenious con artist Rehan devises a diamond heist while trying to outsmart Rajan, his sadistic adversary.

results.title: Paloma
results.overview: Two strangers experience the magic of their unexpected connection one night in Mexico City.

results.title: Final Twist
results.overview: Monica has a podcast and Alex has a dark secret. Sometimes, meeting up with online friends in real life isn't such a good idea.

results.title: 27 Nights
results.overview: When a woman is admitted by her daughters to a psychiatric clinic for her carefree ways, an expert must judge if she is ill or simply wants to enjoy life.

results.title: Eye for an Eye
results.overview: Anna, grieving the sudden death of her parents, relocates from New York to a small Florida town to live with the grandmother she has never met. Isolated, vulnerable, and in need of friends, she finds brief solace in the company of two local teens. But when she becomes complicit to their unforgivable act of violence, she finds herself ensnared by Mr. Sandman – the twisted soul of a tormented child who haunts bullies’ dreams before feasting on their eyeballs when they finally wake - Anna must right her wrong before becoming a victim of this gruesome curse.

results.title: A Poet
results.overview: An aging poet finds purpose mentoring Yurlady, a talented teen, though exposing her to the poetry scene might be unwise. His own poetic pursuits led nowhere, leaving him a stereotypical obscure writer.

results.title: Sacrifice
results.overview: Follows the lives and unbreakable love between Blake Robinson; a headstrong and respected military officer who falls for the the heartwarming humanitarian James Hunter. Their sense of duty pushes this connection to its very limits.
